remarks: Don't miss this move in ready 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo in Rolling Ridge! With 736 square feet, the layout is open and airy, featuring a refreshed kitchen and bath with clean, stylish finishes. Step out from the living area onto your private balcony with wooded views-perfect for morning coffee or unwinding after work. The bedroom is spacious with great natural light and plenty of closet space. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, a private storage room, and access to the community's pool, pond, and tennis courts. Heat and hot water are included in the HOA. All in a quiet, residential setting just minutes from Route 7, the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and everything Norwalk has to offer.
